## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / internal
- [ ] Release / infrastructure

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes (lint + typecheck + tests)
- [ ] Public API changes are intentional and reflected in the exported surface tests
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or the public surface changed
- [ ] No unrelated changes bundled in

## Notes for reviewers

Anything specific to look at (trade-offs, follow-ups, risk).
